fields.title: Backend Developer Intern
fields.description: Join our team to build scalable APIs and microservices for our analytics platform. Work with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
fields.requirements: Knowledge of Python and Django. Familiarity with RESTful APIs and relational databases.

fields.title: Frontend Developer Intern
fields.description: Work on modern UI components for our SaaS dashboard using React.js and TypeScript.
fields.requirements: Experience with JavaScript, React.js, and CSS frameworks.

fields.title: Data Science Intern
fields.description: Assist in building machine learning models for predictive analytics. Work closely with our data engineering team.
fields.requirements: Strong foundation in statistics and Python. Experience with pandas and scikit-learn.

fields.title: AI Research Intern
fields.description: Support our artificial intelligence research team in developing and evaluating machine learning models. Work on computer science problems applied to real-world datasets.
fields.requirements: Background in computer science or artificial intelligence. Familiarity with Python and deep learning frameworks.

fields.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
fields.description: Build and maintain web applications using Django and React.js. Collaborate with the computer science team on software architecture decisions.
fields.requirements: Knowledge of Python, Django, and JavaScript. Understanding of software engineering principles.

fields.title: DevOps Intern
fields.description: Assist in managing CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. Work alongside our engineering team to automate deployments.
fields.requirements: Basic understanding of Linux and cloud platforms. Experience with Git and scripting.

fields.title: Mobile Developer Intern
fields.description: Develop and maintain mobile applications for Android and iOS platforms using React Native.
fields.requirements: Experience with JavaScript and mobile development frameworks.

fields.title: Cybersecurity Intern
fields.description: Assist in vulnerability assessments and security audits of our systems. Work with the security team on threat analysis.
fields.requirements: Knowledge of networking and security fundamentals. Familiarity with Linux environments.

fields.title: UX/UI Design Intern
fields.description: Create wireframes, prototypes, and design systems for our web and mobile products.
fields.requirements: Portfolio demonstrating UI/UX projects. Proficiency in design tools.
fields.desired_skills: Figma, UI/UX Design, Responsive Design, Prototyping

fields.title: Data Engineering Intern
fields.description: Design and maintain data pipelines for our analytics platform. Work with SQL databases and cloud storage solutions.
fields.requirements: Knowledge of SQL and Python. Familiarity with data warehousing concepts.
